Results.ReviewText:
Relatively easy to assemble. The sear zone is nice. 

The grill temperature guage does not seem accurate. Showing temps of 600-700 degrees when sear zone is enabled, but the times to get meats up to temperature are indicating 350-450 degrees. So the temp guage is mostly useless.

I like that the bottom of the grill slides out for easier cleaning. However, this introduces a slight risk. If it is not fully seated and there is a gap, the gas tank and hose are immediately below it.

I liked the push-button starting system on the old grills better. The new system is inconsistent. Sometimes it lights and sometimes it doesn't.

Despite those small quirks, it seems like a nice grill and should last a long time with maintenance.

Results.ReviewText: The grill is fine, but I hate that there are only 2 wheels, and cheap plastic ones at that. There’s no convenient way to move the grill around, no handle on the opposite side of the wheels to help lift it so you can wheel it around. My old girl had four sturdy casters on it, that was much better.  I do like that the whole grill pan at underneath comes out. That makes for easy cleaning, and I’m glad you did away with having to lift the propane tank on a hook so that you can monitor the propane level. For the cost of the grill, though you should’ve included a propane gauge, which I had to purchase separately.
Results.Title: Put back the 4 wheels.

Haven’t tried the “sear station” yet so can’t comment on that.

Results.ReviewText: Purchased brand new and it shipped with a faulty gas hose (Natural Gas). Submitted support case with Weber and sent pictures (at their request) of both ends of the hose and the quick disconnect fitting. They sent me a new quick disconnect fitting which did not resolve the problem. I noticed the hose end that connects to the disconnect fitting is missing the horizontal bar that engages with the petcock valve is missing. Without that bar, gas won’t flow. According to Weber Support, the hose is out of stock, no ETA, and at the time of writing this, no update from the Order Management team. Bought the grill to use on July 4th…nearly one month later I still have a useless grill.
Results.Title: Not the Quality Weber I Grew Up With….disappointed

Results.ReviewText: I bought this 2 months ago and have used it several times. While it works as expected, I was disappointed in some of the corners they cut to save money. They installed cheap plastic wheels that I don’t anticipate will last a year, and only 2 of them, which limits maneuverability. The back is completely open, which allows easy access for animals to get in to the grease tray and make a mess. In retrospect, I should have purchased a Monument grill. They appear to be a same or better quality for much less. The main reason I went with Weber was I needed one immediately and because their side trays folded down where they didn’t on the Monument Grill. I liked where it could be stored in a much smaller area. I bought a Turtle brand cover, which I like.
Results.Title: Cutting cost corners
